about: Machine-readable marker regions on the live-lab test card (plan 178 U7). Rects are [x, y, width, height] normalized to the card viewport (0..1, origin top-left); the card fills the captured display. Every region is a grid of square cells painted pure white (bit 1) or pure black (bit 0) on a black quiet-zone plate. Decode by sampling the inner part of each cell's luma; no OCR. The markers sit above the flash layer, so they stay decodable on flash frames.

scene.encoding: one row of dataBits + 3 cells: guard 1, data bits most significant first, even parity over the data bits, guard 0
scene.meaning: card scene id 0..15 set by the harness with setStep({ sceneId })

step.encoding: one row of dataBits + 3 cells: guard 1, data bits most significant first, even parity over the data bits, guard 0
step.meaning: scenario step index modulo 1024 set by the harness with setStep({ index })
